### BetterPV 1.2.0

Huge update consisting of suggestions provided to me by members of my discord (thanks Josh, 2short2hit, cabelodemelanciathuglife, DerMaster any anyone else for suggestions).

**new**

- Added a new **Essence** subtab to Home, showing all 11 essence shops, instead of them being located in random spots
- Added a **Farming Fortune calculator** to Garden! It should be accurate, reference point is elite farmers (this took forever)
- Added a **Kuudra Gear Checklist** to Crimson Isle, showing which important items and armour you own, what needs upgrading and what you're missing. (if anything is wrong, blame josh)
- Added **recent player searches**! The search box now remembers your last 3 pved players letting you swap easily
- Added a **Socials** dropdown next to the profile selector, with links to Plancke, SkyCrypt, EliteBot, Coflnet and NameMC.
- Added **last-online timestamps** for offline players and location information for online players.
- Added a new **Collections popup**, showing collection tiers, progress, rewards and crafting recipes when you click a collection.
- Added **Minion upgrade costs**, including the materials and coins needed for each upgrade, plus a cheapest-next-upgrade option.
- Added a new **Trophies** subtab to Fishing, showing trophy fish, frogs, their tiers and discovery progress instead of having a flippable pannel.
- Added **Sea Creature stats** to Fishing, including kills, Dolphin milestone progress and Festival sharks. (i really dont like how thhis looks but i moved trophies so i had to put smthn)

**improvements**

- **Authentication sessions now refresh automatically in the background**, meaning you shouldn't need to keep reauthenticating during longer Minecraft sessions.
- Improved **networth tooltips** with category percentages, item values when holding Shift and more information about how prices are calculated.
- Improved **Garden** with level overflow, crop milestone progress, Farming Fortune and better visitor tracking.
- Improved **Jacob's Contests** with correct placements, personal bests and better medal information.
- Improved **Mining and Foraging** layouts, including better HOTM/HOTF tree scaling, selected presets, whisper balances and Hunting information.
- Improved **Attribute Shards** with rarity sorting, better icons and tooltips showing the cost to max each shard.
- Improved **Kuudra**, Abiphone and Crimson Isle information, including better gear detection, quest progress and missing contact costs.
- Improved **Dungeons** with better Croesus rewards, floor time tooltips and the missing Wither shop perk.
- Improved **Sacks** with better sorting, sack values and handling for unowned sacks containing items.
- Improved **Pets, Auctions and Museum** with more accurate sorting, values and item details.
- Improved **loadouts** with HOTM/HOTF presets and layouts that fit better on smaller screens.
- Improved **profile switching**! Clicking a co-op member now keeps you on the same SkyBlock profile and tab where possible.
- Cleaned up a load of text, tooltips and labels across the PV to make things easier to understand. (because josh is stupid)

**changes**

- The status box now shows where online players are, or how long ago offline players were last seen, instead of just saying Online or Offline.
- Renamed the Dungeon **Chests** subtab to croesus since this is where the data comes from
- Combined Safari information into the **Hunting** page.
- Removed the Fishing Bag page because Hypixel removed the item into a new sack.
- Some Farming Fortune, mining, stat and other displayed values may change due to updated calculations. (lmk if anything seems wildly off)

**fixes**

- Fixed some online statuses showing incorrectly when Hypixel doesn't provide a logout time.
- Fixed Jacob's Contest placements sometimes being off by one or showing unclaimed contests as first place.
- Fixed HOTM and HOTF calculations mixing together multiple saved presets.

### BetterPV 1.1.2

Added mod compatibility (BetterPV can now update SkyHanni/DyeAddons), performance improvements and PV resizing!

**new**

- Added **adjustable PV scaling** from 75% to 150%, in 5% increments. Change it using the slider in the bottom-right corner. Right-click to reset to 100%.
- Added **SkyHanni and DyeAddons compatibility**! Opening a profile in BetterPV now shares its data with supported features in both mods. (It might say the data came from SBPV because we're using the same compatibility system.)

**improvements**

- The PV now scales independently of Minecraft's GUI scale, meaning you can choose its size without changing the rest of your interface.
- Improved scaling for smaller windows. The PV automatically adjusts to your window size and GUI settings to prevent it from getting cut off.
- Improved mouse interactions, scrolling, tooltips and player-model rendering at different scales, preventing clipping and positioning issues.
- Improved profile loading by preventing duplicate requests for the same player.
- **Coflnet auction details now load when you open the Auctions tab**, rather than making unnecessary requests while viewing other pages.
- Improved authentication session handling to reduce unnecessary reauthentication requests.

**fixes**

- Fixed recurring `AUTH_COOLDOWN` errors that could prevent profiles from loading even when authentication had previously succeeded.
- Fixed valid authentication sessions being discarded after certain API errors.
- Fixed authentication refreshes attempting to run before Mojang's proof cooldown had expired.
- Fixed a Garden crop parsing issue that could incorrectly display a crop as `3`.

**note**

Some large profiles may still take a while to load due to Hypixel's API response times. This update adds better diagnostics to help investigate those delays, but doesn't completely eliminate them.

## BetterPV 1.1.1

Fixed auth and rate limit issues from 1.1.0

### BetterPV 1.1.0

biG update adding a load of new profile data, records and fixes across the pv.

**new**

- Added a new **Records** subtab to Home, covering dragons, races, Mythos/Diana, combat records, Jerry’s Workshop and Spooky Festival stats.
- Added **Dungeon Chests** history for recent Catacombs, Master Mode and Kuudra runs, including rewards, rerolls, chest state and party information.
- Added a missing accessories page, including MP gain, cost to max, coins per MP, family replacements and sell credit (basically the same as skyhelper).
- Added missing pets to the Pets page at the bottom as suggested.
- added some garden stats: plot map, unlock costs, crop upgrades, composter costs, copper totals and Sowdust progress.
- Expanded Chocolate Factory with prestige, Hitman, factions, Chocobits, Hoppity and employee information. (new api stuff!! yay)
- Added new safari api data, including undiscovered critters and sparklings.
- Added undiscovered Abiphone contacts, requirements and better completion tracking.
- Added forge completion/remaining-time display.
- Added combined BetterPV/DRT update notices.

**improvements**

- Reworked skill averages, overflow skill XP and skill tooltips.
- Improved stat calculation, including Reaper Peppers, Bee Saliva and Isopod Husks. (its still off by alot)
- Better profile chat clicks: party, guild, officer, co-op and social/profile messages can open `/pv`. (again..)
- Added co-op join dates in the profile selector.
- Large tooltips can now scroll in both directions. (scroll for up/down, shift+scroll for left/right)
- Improved item, skull and CIT/resource-pack compatibility.
- Improved museum loading states and sorting; owned entries now appear before missing entries. (same as pets and abiphone)
- Added better mob names, K/D information and top death causes.
- Improved dungeon overview spacing. (it was pissing me off)
- Fixed mining powder and Foraging whisper balances to show available amounts. (FOR THE FOURTH TIME)
- Updated Magical Power handling, accessory families and rarity support. (should match real MP now)
- Updated networth valuation to use current full enchantment values. (previously used skyhanni and skyhelpers reduced values, my calc should now be true values)
- Added safer retries for prices, Hypixel item data and collections after authentication becomes available.

**changes**

- `/pv` temporarily uses GUI scale 2 while open, then restores your previous scale when closed. (no more weird sizing)
- Removed the Museum **Misc** filter. (hypixel removed it)
- Some displayed values may change due to more accurate skill, networth, Magical Power, mining and Foraging calculations. (lmk if anything seems vastly off)

**fixes**

- Better handling for missing or delayed item data.
- Improved icon and texture fallbacks.
- Various profile parsing, UI, loading-state and data-quality fixes.

**security**

- BetterPV now uses a new challenge based authentication system with shorter lived sessions and signed protected API requests. To use the PV you are required to update.

### BetterPV 1.0.2

A pretty big update focused on making pv load faster

**new stuff**
- Added shared cosmetic rendering between BetterPV, DRT and Skylist so cosmetics dont fight for priority anymore
- Cosmetic gradients are now smooth and animate properly
- Party, Guild, Officer and Co-op chat names can now be clicked to `/pv`
- Hypixel profile links in chat now open BetterPV `/pv`
- Player models now show the correct skin

**/pv speed improvements**
- Your own UUID and tab-list UUIDs now skip unnecessary Mojang lookups
- Added a persistent UUID cache
- Duplicate player requests are merged
- Election data is cached
- Auction requests are reused when switching profiles
- swapped alot of loading to lazily load when needed
- Gear, stats and armour now share the same inventory decode

**other changes**
- Switched prices from `athen.aerii.xyz/prices` to `api.vyriv.dev/v1/prices`
- Removed random chat-name guessing to stop false `/pv` matches on mod messages and banners
